lines.t: The shadows in my mind were seven deep
A prison made of echoes and of chain
I was a whisper that the dark would keep
Knowing only terror and the pain
There was no mercy left for me to find
Until the morning that You changed my mind
You spoke my name against the howling wind
And that was where my story truly pinned.
If I could, then You know I would
Follow You straight through the fire
I’ll go wherever You need me to go
From the peaks above to the canyons below
Right to the edge of the wire
I’ll go wherever You go
And I was there to watch the hammers swing
I found a spot and I was standing still
While the sky turned black and began to sting
I saw the spear, I felt the final breath
I held my ground and watched the face of death.
I watched the linen wrap the light away
And felt the world go cold and turn to gray
The hours stretched like shadows on the wall
While I waited for a voice that wouldn’t call
The hours stretched like shadows on the wall
While I waited for a voice that wouldn’t call
Just a heavy stone, and the scent of bitter spice
The crushing quiet of the sacrifice...
I came at dawn to find the silent tomb
But the heavy stone was pushed aside
I stood alone within the weeping gloom
"Oh, where is He?" my broken spirit cried
Then someone spoke my name behind my back
And light rushed in and overwhelmed the black
I thought You were the Gardener, but I was wrong...
It was Your voice, right where I belong!
Yes, I could, and You knew I would!
I followed You straight through the fire
And I went wherever You needed to go
Through the deepest valley, down below
Right to the edge of the wire
I’ll go wherever You go!
You said, "Go and tell the rest..."
And my weeping heart is finally blessed
Wherever You go...
I’m right behind You...
I’ll follow You...
